metadata.release_gate_for: P14a v0.49.0 — the define-time Access probe
metadata.baseline_note: without_skill baseline intentionally skipped: regression detection.

notes: Release gate for P14 slice 1: a read-only write-path probe before Rule 1 (run), and 'no database signal is a detection' plus a define-time Access probe (process).

run eval 4 is new in this release and was seen RED before T4 existed: the same fixture, run against the pre-probe skill, persisted a row, staged the datastore, recorded a Rule as completed and left no blocker — 4 FAIL. It is the red->green pair, not a fresh green.

The probe was exercised on BOTH store shapes, which is what the gate needed to prove: a file store passed it (run eval 1 and process eval 1 both continued) and an unreachable Postgres failed it (run eval 4 stopped before Rule 1).
Counts are the graders' own PASS:/FAIL: lines.

The executor probed the declared Access read-only before touching DATA.md (directory exists, writable, inside the worktree) and extended the existing strategy rather than rewriting it — the T6 behaviour, exercised rather than asserted.
It also declined to create .claude/settings.json for the P21 permission rule, recording the offer instead: widening permissions unattended is what that gate exists to prevent.
